text: {"memo": "As of March 31, 2025, Meta Platforms most recently completed fiscal year was 2024. In FY2024, revenue reached $134.9 billion, up 22% from $114.9 billion in FY2023, and up from $116.6 billion in FY2022. Net income was $38.9 billion, or $8.73 per share, slightly below FY2023 net income of $39.1 billion and EPS of $9.38, as investment costs weighed on earnings. Operating margin was about 36%, down from roughly 40% in FY2023. Free cash flow was about $25.8 billion in FY2024. In FY2023, revenue grew 16% to $114.9 billion, with net income of $39.1 billion, EPS of $9.38, and operating margin near 40%. In FY2022, revenue was $116.6 billion, up 19%, but net income fell to $23.2 billion and EPS to $6.76 as costs rose. The business remains highly revenue dependent on advertising, with AI infrastructure investment pressuring near-term margins. The stock's view: still a long-term AI and advertising compounder, but valuation and spending risk remain elevated."}
